notes.title: Announcing TRUST!
notes.content:
Hello, fellow vampires!

[b]We're thrilled to announce TRUST, a new FPS game from creators of Forgive Me Father series![/b]

Officially revealed during the Boomstock 2024 event, TRUST is a vampire-themed FPS with immersive elements, featuring comic-style graphics, lots of blood, and surprisingly stylish patrol units!

Take a closer look at the Announcement Teaser!

[previewyoutube=gkf9XRSyO6g;full][/previewyoutube]

Make sure to follow us on social media to stay updated on everything about TRUST, and don't forget to add TRUST to your wishlist! And remember, BLOOD IS EVERYTHING!
